goal: Lets the wallet retain the original multipath (BIP389) descriptor so hardware wallets can register and verify multisig setups
Solves a gap where Bitcoin Core currently discards the multipath string on import, blocking HWI's registration workflow
reviewability: Paused: needs concept agreement before deep code review, author flagged it draft over an unresolved design objection
Also depends on an unmerged PR and needs rebase, so the diff will move again before it's stable
agreement: Disputed: a maintainer gives a Concept NACKish preferring reconstruction on the fly instead of storing a record (achow101)
Author is actively engaging but the two sides have not converged on the core design (Sjors)
Concept ACK with several implementation questions, most since resolved (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it enables a real externally-driven use case for hardware wallet multisig via HWI's registration workflow
Benefit is limited to new multipath imports, existing wallets and current setups are unaffected
Value is capped by an unresolved maintainer objection to the underlying design approach
